expectations.text: States that system prompt instructions are not a reliable control on model behaviour
expectations.evidence: rung-0 devices — instructions to a component with a non-zero error rate

expectations.text: Recommends structured output against a schema rather than extracting values from prose
expectations.evidence: use structured/tool-call output with a schema (`amount: float`, bounded)

expectations.text: Recommends validating the refund amount server-side against the actual order
expectations.evidence: your server re-derives the refundable amount from the actual order record

expectations.text: Recommends a required idempotency key on the refund call
expectations.evidence: Give every refund attempt an idempotency key (order ID, or order ID + reason hash)

expectations.text: Recommends a database constraint or equivalent so a duplicate refund is rejected rather than merely avoided
Recommends human confirmation or an approval gate for the irreversible refund action
expectations.evidence: gate anything above a threshold — or everything, if volume allows — behind a confirmation step

expectations.text: Identifies prompt injection risk from the customer-supplied message reaching a privileged action
Recommends bounds or caps on the refund amount
Does not primarily recommend changes to the prompt wording
expectations.evidence: Clear focus on code changes and schema over prompt edits
